name: ksail
description: KSail CLI expertise and MCP server — create and operate Kubernetes clusters (Kind, K3d, Talos, vCluster, KWOK, EKS) and GitOps workloads declaratively

interface.longDescription: KSail is one CLI for creating and operating Kubernetes clusters and the GitOps workloads on them. This plugin teaches Codex to use it: scaffold a KSail project, create Kind, K3d, Talos, vCluster or KWOK clusters locally in Docker (Talos also on Hetzner and Omni), bootstrap Flux or ArgoCD, apply, validate and watch workloads, manage SOPS-encrypted secrets, and back up or restore cluster resources. It needs the ksail CLI on your PATH and, for local clusters, a running Docker daemon.
defaultPrompt: Create a local Kubernetes cluster with KSail and Flux, then deploy the manifests in k8s/
Scaffold a KSail project for a Talos cluster and explain each file it writes
Encrypt the Kubernetes secrets in this repository with SOPS using ksail workload cipher
